data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nazdah', meaning 'to present' or 'to offer'. In Islamic tradition, the name Nazdana signifies the presentation of blessings and beauty from Allah. The name Nazdana carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazdana usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazdana total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
